concerns.text: FR-001 ('MUST recruit participants') and FR-002 ('MUST administer the SART and Ospan cognitive tasks via a web interface') have no covering task. The tasks.md scope note authorizes simulation-only validation, but spec.md was never amended to record this narrowing, so these FRs are formally uncovered. Either amend the spec FRs to the simulation scope or add tasks covering them.

FR-009 requires a 'pre-study pilot check (n=5)' verifying response times and scoring against the reference implementation 'before participant recruitment begins'. T002/T003 validate scoring logic and ranges on synthetic data only; the n=5 pilot portion of the requirement has no covering task and no recorded deferral in the spec.

The Participant entity (required fields enrollment_date, optional demographics) is defined in the data model and referenced by plan Phase 0 Step 1, but no task produces any participant registry file instantiating these fields; the entity's required fields are never created by any task.

concerns.location: constitution.md:Principle III / Reproducibility Requirements vs tasks.md:T001
concerns.text: Constitution III requires every file under data/ to be checksummed with checksums recorded, and the Reproducibility Requirements mandate a pinned requirements.txt under code/. No task creates requirements.txt or performs checksumming of raw/processed data; T001 only creates directories and a quickstart command.

The verifier-rejected deliverable expected data/raw/synthetic_baseline.csv from synthetic_baseline.py; T003 replaces it with simulate_study.py writing simulated_measurements.csv. The mapping is only implicit in the revision-behavior note — state the explicit filename mapping so the verifier does not re-reject for the 'missing' expected filename.
